anomalies.name: Fragments of Ghornfell
anomalies.description: Fragments of Ghornfell: 57.1 s — 4.0 s faster than every reference run (best TexasPete 61.1 s).  Possible skip or route not in the reference set.

textNotes.text: could be faster but i don't think i'll do more of this

textNotes.author: @Jamspoon6
textNotes.text: Sweet run, do you know if the extraction unlock for the keep is patched too or is it just the first one? Cus that one is such a sweet skip

textNotes.author: @ShadowStalkerTM
textNotes.text:
all the extraction skips in my run seems to be patched since it doesn't work for me anymore (only did 3-4 raids since patch)
the kuldra skip at 2:07 is the only thing that worked for me in all the runs i did

textNotes.author: @onionknight69
textNotes.text: People say it's patched. Must have just been on my end but i was able to do the extraction bug on my 2nd run today 9/27. Started off normal farming stuff and left after 1st extraction and when i came back the 2nd one was there and then all the rest after i left.

textNotes.author: @AidantheLengthy
textNotes.text: Can you explain how the first teleport trick unlocks the 3rd spawn point?

textNotes.author: @ShadowStalkerTM
textNotes.text:
not for me but one of the commenters said the extraction bug started workeing for him after a normal raid.
only thing i can confrm still working is kuldra fight skip (2:07)
